Name: Thunder and Frogs Sounds for Custom Music
Author: Chread
Description:
[size=5][color=#ffd966]I highly recommend my remake of this content pack that only requires [/color][color=#ffd966][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿! Check it out here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20489]Thunder and Frog Sounds for Content Patcher[/url]. It will not influence your game in any negative way and compatibility stays the same. [/color][/size]

Hello everyone!

This mod aims to make the feel of rainy days more realistic. Currently the game has some weird sounds which are suppose to be frogs, but they really don't resemble a frog sound. So I thought to give it a change. Other than that, I thought the thunder sounds could use some work too.

In my experience this mod gives the game a much more "cozy" feel on rainy days.

To see an example of what this mod sounds like press the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7450?tab=videos]Videos[/url]" tab.



[b]Installation:[/b] You put the "[CP] Thunder and Frog Sounds" file in your Mods folder. This mod requires you to have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043?tab=files&BH=2]Custom Music[/url] installed.
[b]Compatibility:[/b]  Piano valley and all other Custom Music mods work, as long as they don't change the frog or thunder sounds (which almost no mods do). I haven't tested it with other types of sound mods. If you run into any compatibility troubles let me know.



[i]Future plans:[/i]  Compress sound files
﻿ ﻿ ﻿Add in wind sounds (maybe)
﻿ ﻿ ﻿Convert to Content Patcher or Sound Tweaker

If you have any suggestions let me know.


Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3946892]MissCoriel[/url]﻿ for helping me out a bit.
For credits to the original sound uploaders, see the "credit.txt" file in the mod.

Check out my other content packs [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/chrisdegod/mods]here[/url].
